# Chapter Three: In Search Of

Lord Seer Rogan sat upon the throne of judgement the deep purple robes of his office wrapped around his shoulders like armor as he stared down the four pathetic men now kneeling before him. “You are charged with the theft of the Lord Seers food stock and then the abandonment of your post, how do you plead” Loric read from the parchment held in his hand. The four men having taken food to feed their families and then taken it to them during the time they were supposed to be working the fields for the Empress. The Lord Seer had instituted rationing despite the commoners complaints of starvation to ensure he could send more food stock to the troops, he would not tolerate the whining and complaining of the common people who’s only reason for existing was to serve him and by serving him, the Empress. The fact that he let them eat at all should be a reason to celebrate he thought, his jaw clenching in anger as his eyes bore into the four men. “Pathetic, how dare you steal from me” Rogan said none of the men daring to make eye contact with him.

He stood from the throne taking a step down closer to these men. “But, you have stated that your families are too large for the small amount of food I give you, is this correct?” he asked the four men, his tone almost gentle and finally the men looked up and Rogan could see hope in their eyes. All four nodded. “Yes my lord, we all have multiple children, what you offer barely feeds the adults and our children cry from starvation, we did not mean any disrespect towards you lord, we only wish to take care of our children” the man on the left proclaimed and Rogan smiled at him. “I can understand this, Loric” he called to his assistant who nodded at him. “Have the children executed and display the bodies in the courtyard as an example of what happens when you steal from me” he said, the men erupted into screams of protest, the man who spoke his face twisted in anger launched himself at the Lord Seer. “Pathetic” he said as he raised his hand calling forth the power as the man stopped four feet from the Lord Seer, his body hanging in the air.

“I would kill you for your insolence, but I feel letting you live to be a worst punishment” he said and then with a flick of his hand sent the man crashing against the back stone wall, hard enough to knock him out, but not hard enough to kill him. The men were taken out as the soldiers were given their orders to kill the children, they too left the hall, leaving only Rogan and Loric left. “My Lord” he heard Loric call and with a sigh turned towards his assistant. “What is it Loric?” Rogan asked gently, but he could see the young man’s face, the pain and horror at ordering the death of the children.

He knew the young man was going to balk at this and he understood, so Rogan walked over and put his arm around the young man “Its important we quash all resistance Loric, this will ensure we have no more problems and that our commoners stay in line, allowing us to concentrate on whats important, we have entire species to save my young assistant. When this is done you will be celebrated for your strength and will to do what was necessary” he said gently to the young man. Loric lowered his eyes nodding to his Lord. “Of course, my Lord” he whispered trying to hide the tears that streamed down his face. “Do we have any more of these today?”

Rogan asked waving his hand at the large room used as a court and Loric shook his head “No My Lord, that was the last” he finished and Rogan squeezed the young man’s shoulder reassuringly “Take the rest of the day Loric, rest, I will see you tomorrow” he whispered to him and the young man walked off Leaving Rogan alone in the room.

He smiled as he looked at the area, he used to dispense justice, this room defined his reign and what happened here would help write the story of his dedication to humanity and to saving it he thought his eyes shone like that of a true believer. Standing there he soaked in the power that surrounded the room. Power was a drug and he felt a rush when dispensing it he mused. These people were a means to an end, the Empress had spent years showing him the true purpose of the common people were to serve the crown and in doing so becoming the foundation of a great empire.

He understood this, Rogan lived it and he would ensure that his people would work to serve him and sometimes that meant that some would have to be made an example of, by showing them that he would punish any devation from his orders without mercy, he would create a smooth running machine that would supply the armies and in doing so make him the envy of the chosen 12. Rogan left the room, the echo of a smile still on his face as he entered the private quarters. As he began to gently remove the purple robe, appreciating the way the soft fabric felt as he ran his hand over it, folding the robe and placing it in the closet a light knock came at the door.

With a sigh he closed the closet and turned “Come in” he said and Captain Postric entered the small chambers that Rogan now called his own. “Sir, the two prisoners are talking and we might have some information that you would be interested in” he stated standing at attention as he always did in Rogan’s presence, it was one of the reasons that Rogan enjoyed having the captain around, the man understood his place and showed respect to those above him. Rogan nodded “Which prisoners?” he asked trying to remember what he had asked the other man to do, it was important he did remember that, but there was so much to do in getting a territory organized.

“The messenger and the mage my lord” he stated, and Rogan remembered. “Let’s go at once” he said heading out the door ahead of the captain, if these two men were indeed talking then they could tell him the location of the one the Empress sought, and that information was worth its weight in gold he thought. He rapidly walked down the hall coming to the door that led below, throwing it open the smell of blood and body odor hit him and the Lord Seer almost lost his lunch, god it stank he thought stepping back. Postric was there, handing him an orange and a cloth “Here my lord, this will help” he said, Rogan looking doubtful, but taking the two items, placing the cloth to his face the heavy scent of orange overpowered any other as he entered the stairs and made his way below.

The lower level was dark and damp, Rogan doing his best not to tough the wet and slimy stone as he descended the slick steps, reaching the bottom he waited for postric to go ahead of him. Walking down the narrow halls, past the heavy wooden doors of the dungeon area, that was one thing he would appreciate about Galen, the man had taken care to create the perfect place to house and torture those who displeased the crown. Rogan, holding his breath, squeezed more of the orange onto the cloth, replacing it and taking a deep breath. This was no place for a lord he thought. Captain Postric stopped at one of the doors and opening it waited for Rogan to enter.

The Lord saw the two men, hanging naked in the center of the small cell, blood dripping from fresh wounds on there torso. Postric had done a thorough job he thought, appreciating the layer upon layer of marks on these men, both had been down here for over a week and the Captain had taken care to inflict damage and then move to another area until the first one was healed, allowing him to inflict fresh pain without killing or bleeding these men out.

Walking In the captain prodded the first one, Rogan looked and spotted the telltale tattoo of a mage, which explained the crystal harness around his waste, grounding out his ability to use his gift Rogan thought approvingly. “Tell the Lord Seer what you told me” Postric yelled prodding the man again. The Mage stirred, finally coming awake after a few more rough prods from the Captain. “Tell him what you told me” Potric repeated. Rogan could see the unfocused eyes, this man had been pushed to the edge, his mind almost broken he thought.

“A man, a stranger came into my shop with a woman, the woman was known to me, he was peculiar so without his knowledge I used a power stone and tested his ability, he was powerful my lord, but had no markings of a mage” the man mumbled, struggling through the words and finally getting them out. Rogan took another step forward “Who was this man?” he asked but the mage had passed out yet again, with a nod to postric the captain began to prod the prisoner again until he stirred “Tell the lord the name of this man” the captain yelled “Marcus my lord, the woman called him Marcus” he said.

Then a groan came from the other side of the room, Rogan turning to regard the messenger, Veric, that was his name “Messenger Veric, what do you know of this Marcus?” he asked but the Messenger didn’t speak just stood staring at Rogan, he could see the hate in the Messengers eyes and smiled. Yes of course he would despise him he thought. Postric began to walk towards the prisoner but Rogan held up a hand, this one was his he thought. Summoning his power, he began to exert pressure on the man’s groin, slowly increasing it until the man began to scream and howl, his body squirming as he tried to get away from the pain. “Yes Messenger, I can do this all day, you will tell me what I want to know or this will continue” Rogan purred, enjoying the moment, watching the man, helpless in agony that only Rogan could stop, it was power at its truest form he thought still smiling as the man howled louder.

Eventually the Messenger told him everything, how he had met Marcus what they had talked about and where he had said he was from. Rogan left the dungeon and ascended back to the keep proper a victorious smile on his face as he entered his quarters once against to pack. It took almost two hours to organize the guards and prepare the convoy before Rogan stood there, giving his final orders to Loric. “Sir, I still think you should allow us to find this man, your needed here Postric stated, his tone barely hiding the annoyance at having the Lord Seer usurp his authority on this matter. Rogan simply smiled, he liked Postric but that would only get this man so far if he did not turn his attitude around, his authority was only that which Rogan gave him, the man needed to be reminded of that one in a while, and this was the perfect time. “Captain Postric, I will take these men and hunt down the fugitive myself, this is not a man you could stop, in fact if he wanted to, he would simply kill you with a a thought” Rogan finished. “I am the only one here who will have the ability to bring him down and capture him so that we may transport him to the Empress, did you prepare the mage belt?” he asked. The Captain presenting the box to the lord Seer. Rogan had never had to wear one, of course until recently his powers wouldn’t have been a threat to anyone. But he had seen them work, it had the ability to ground out the power that a Mage gathered to themselves before sending it out as a spell or force of will.

He would incapacitate this Marcus and then once he put the belt on him, put him in the caged cart they were bringing, finally delivering him to the Empress personally. The rewards he would receive from his Empress would be the envy of the chosen he knew. Smiling he started out with the precession. “Where to first sir, Postric asked as he rode next to the lord Seer, Rogan smiling as he thought about his quarry and the rewards that were in store for him. “The farm, where he lived with the woman” he said. Closing his eyes Rogan reached out with his power, finding the two Screamers as they canvassed the woods, they had the ability to pickup power and though it had been quite a while since Marcus had been there, he had hoped the two of them still might find a trail that would tell them where he had gone. If not, then they would use traditional methods until they got close enough.

But once they did and once, the two screamers that served him picked up the trail of the Mage they would not stop until he was found. The group rode towards the remnants of the farm.

Rogan looked over the derelict building that stood stalwart and charred, it was an unremarkable piece of property he thought as he surveyed the dilapidated barn and animal pens, anything of value having been pilfered well before his taking over the territory. “What happened here Captain” he asked as Postric had his men survey the property looking for any clues that might have been left either as to the life he had lived or to his eventual evacuation of it. They had come up with nothing, nor had they been able to find anything more then a biline as to the death of six collectors the day the building burned. “I fear we may never know my lord” Postric said coming back after dismissing his men to their horses. “I am not sure what we do now as there is no indication where this Marcus went once, he left here” he finished knowing his words wouldn’t please the Lord Seer. Rogan simple smiled, his eyes closed, what postric didn’t know was that a faint trail had been found and the screamers were heading south looking for more.

The group headed south, finding only a few abandoned camps and no sign that they had come this way. Rogan stayed out for almost two weeks before returning unsuccessfully to his keep. Rogan

could not sleep nor could he eat, dammit he thought he had been so close to finding the man who the Empress had sought.

On the third day however, things changed. Rogan had been eating breakfast when the door burst open “What is the meaning of this” he said annoyed at the interruption as a man covered with the dirt of riding long distance, entered the room “Im sorry my Lord, a letter from the Empress” he said, bowing and handing Rogan a sealed parchment.

Taking the letter, he dismissed the rider and quickly opened the letter, He read through it twice, the smile returning to his face as he did. “Loric, prepare my horse, I am leaving, tell captain Postric I wish four of his best soldiers to ride with me” he yelled, getting up the unfinished breakfast forgotten as he quickly dressed and prepared to leave. Loric entered the room “My Lord?” he said, not understanding what his Lord was doing, he had just returned, what could have caused him to want to leave again he wondered, watching as an Agitated Lord Seer, ransacked the room looking for items he threw into the leather sack on the bed. “He has left the Order and heading North Loric, he will pass by here and I mean to capture him” Rogan said, moving the young man as he walked past him, heading for the main doors and to the stables.

“You are in charge again, I hope to be gone only a week, prepare the dungeon, when I return I will be bringing my prisoner here” he said excitedly. Loric Nodded “My Lord, how do we know this?” he asked, who could have passed this information onto him he wondered. Rogan stopped turning to look at his assistant the smile still on his face. “Lord Aster, the head of the Order, hoping to spare them the wrath of the Empress, the fool things by giving up Marcus he will be able to keep his order, he doesn’t know the Empress has already dispatched troops to capture the order” he said laughing as if the situation was at all humorous.

Rogan and his troops rode out quickly heading towards the south. “We will find somewhere to wait for my quarry, we ride for a day and then secure a farm or inn, from there we will send out scouts until he is spotted, no one will engage him, he is mine” Ordered Rogan as they rode. Closing his eyes, he passed his orders to the Screamers as they slunk through the woods nearby, Engage him, secure him, run him down, but don’t kill him he thought to the screamers and felt the frustration of being robbed of the murder of anyone, they were simple creatures who’s primal thoughts were easily understood he thought.
